```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  dpi = 300
)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(
  here, ggplot2, dplyr, scales, dampack
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
# Load PSA cache files for all model structures
model_labels <- c("joint", "focused", "separate")
model_display_labels <- c("Model A: Joint", "Model B: Focused", "Model C: Separate")

all_psa_results <- list()

for (i in seq_along(model_labels)) {
  model_label <- model_labels[i]
  cache_file <- here("data", "tidy", paste0("psa_obj_", model_label, ".rds"))

  if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
    all_psa_results[[model_label]] <- readRDS(cache_file)
    cat("Loaded PSA cache for", model_label, "model\n")
  } else {
    warning("PSA cache not found: ", cache_file)
  }
}

psa_available <- length(all_psa_results) > 0
cat("PSA available:", psa_available, "- Loaded", length(all_psa_results), "models\n")
```

```{r calculate-ceacs, include=FALSE}
# Calculate CEACs for each model and combine into single data frame
wtp_range <- seq(0, 100000, by = 2000)

ceac_data <- data.frame()

if (psa_available) {
  for (i in seq_along(model_labels)) {
    model_label <- model_labels[i]
    display_label <- model_display_labels[i]

    psa_obj <- all_psa_results[[model_label]]
    if (is.null(psa_obj)) next

    # Calculate CEAC using dampack
    ceac_obj <- tryCatch({
      dampack::ceac(wtp = wtp_range, psa = psa_obj)
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("CEAC calculation failed for", model_label, ":", e$message, "\n")
      NULL
    })

    if (is.null(ceac_obj)) next

    # ceac_obj is a data frame with columns: WTP, Strategy, Proportion, On_Frontier
    # Add model label and combine
    ceac_obj$Model <- display_label
    ceac_data <- rbind(ceac_data, ceac_obj)
  }
}

cat("CEAC data rows:", nrow(ceac_data), "\n")
if (nrow(ceac_data) > 0) {
  cat("CEAC columns:", paste(names(ceac_data), collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

```{r create-ceac-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
if (nrow(ceac_data) > 0) {
  # Create cleaner strategy labels
  strategy_labels <- c(
    "control" = "Control (FLOX only)",
    "crp" = "CRP Strategy",
    "tlr" = "TLR Strategy",
    "tmb_braf" = "TMB/BRAF Strategy"
  )

  ceac_data$Strategy <- factor(
    ceac_data$Strategy,
    levels = names(strategy_labels),
    labels = strategy_labels
  )

  # Order model facets
  ceac_data$Model <- factor(
    ceac_data$Model,
    levels = c("Model A: Joint", "Model B: Focused", "Model C: Separate")
  )

  # Define colors for strategies
  strategy_colors <- c(
    "Control (FLOX only)" = "gray50",
    "CRP Strategy" = "#E69F00",
    "TLR Strategy" = "#009E73",
    "TMB/BRAF Strategy" = "#0072B2"
  )

  # Create the CEAC plot
  ceac_plot <- ggplot(ceac_data, aes(x = WTP, y = Proportion,
                                      color = Strategy, linetype = Model)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 51000, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) +
    annotate("text", x = 53000, y = 0.05, label = "WTP = \u20AC51K",
             hjust = 0, size = 3, color = "gray40") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      labels = scales::label_currency(prefix = "\u20AC", scale = 0.001, suffix = "K", big.mark = ","),
      breaks = seq(0, 100000, by = 20000)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = strategy_colors, name = "Strategy") +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c("Model A: Joint" = "solid",
                 "Model B: Focused" = "dashed",
                 "Model C: Separate" = "dotted"),
      name = "Model Structure"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Cost-Effectiveness Acceptability Curves",
      subtitle = "Probability of being cost-effective across willingness-to-pay thresholds",
      x = "Willingness-to-Pay Threshold (EUR/QALY)",
      y = "Probability of Being Cost-Effective"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray40"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.margin = margin(t = 10),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(order = 1, nrow = 2),
      linetype = guide_legend(order = 2)
    )

  print(ceac_plot)
} else {
  cat("No CEAC data available. Please run script 12_PSA.R first to generate PSA results.\n")
}
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
if (nrow(ceac_data) > 0) {
  figs_dir <- here("figs")
  if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) {
    dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  ggsave(
    filename = here("figs", "figure4.png"),
    plot = ceac_plot,
    width = 10,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )

  cat("Figure saved to:", here("figs", "figure4.png"), "\n")
}
```
